findings.how_to_check: Run `git status --short linkage_tables replication/results output` to see that no table outputs were regenerated; check `review/handoff_truth_rerun_machineB.md:70-83` for the exact cell discrepancies against machine A's benchmark.
findings.suggested_fix: Execute the table reruns for ABE/JW and HLINK (`LINKAGE/code/00_run_all_tables.do` or component scripts) against the new truth file, verify that the ABE exact-name columns match machine A's benchmark numbers, update the paper exhibits, and commit the regenerated tables alongside the code change.
findings.title: Truth set input was switched to machine A's file but truth-dependent linkage tables and exhibits were not rerun
findings.what_the_code_does: The working-tree change repoints `global D_TRUTH \"$DATA/truth_from_machineA\"` in `LINKAGE/code/shared/paths.do` and updates the preflight path in `replication/run_machineB.do`, switching future linkage scoring from the damaged 36,143,407-pair file to the complete 36,690,338-pair file. However, none of the generated linkage tables (e.g., `linkage_tables/linkage_table_abe_jw*.tex`, `linkage_tables/linkage_table_hlink*.tex`) or derived outputs in the repository were regenerated or updated.
findings.why_it_matters: The existing tables, generated exhibits, and draft statistics remain scored against the damaged truth set that was missing 546,932 pairs (1.49%). As documented in `review/handoff_truth_rerun_machineB.md:70-83`, the full Old ABE verified count shifts from 6,188,445 to 6,283,801 (+95,356) and contradicted count shifts from 344,018 to 348,279. Committing or shipping the code change without regenerating the tables leaves reported paper numbers inconsistent with the code and factually wrong.

findings.how_to_check: Inspect lines 10-14 of `LINKAGE/notes/truth_file_provenance.md`, lines 67-77 of `LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md`, and line 80 of `replication/README.md`, comparing them with `global D_TRUTH` in `LINKAGE/code/shared/paths.do`.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete Step 4 of `review/handoff_truth_rerun_machineB.md`: update `LINKAGE/notes/truth_file_provenance.md` with the resolution from 2026-11-08; update `LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md` and `replication/README.md` to document the true lineage (`CODE/create_linked_sample_for_MLP_training.do`), note the damaged superseded copy and its replacement in `data/truth_from_machineA/`, and correct the August 18 edit description.
findings.title: Documentation in notes, LINKAGE documentation, and replication README still references the damaged truth file and gives contradictory provenance
findings.what_the_code_does: `LINKAGE/code/shared/paths.do:92` cites `LINKAGE/notes/truth_file_provenance.md`, but that note remains in its 2026-11-08 state declaring that 'The paper\'s truth set is B\'s file as it stands today: 36,143,407 one-to-one pairs' and that the discrepancy with A is 'not settled'. Furthermore, `LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md:71-77` and `replication/README.md:80` continue to attribute the truth file to an undocumented extraction from the IPUMS MLP crosswalk (`mlp_census_crosswalk_v2_0.stata.zip`), point to `data/truth/`, and claim the August 18 timestamp was a move rather than an edit.
findings.why_it_matters: An external replicator following the documentation will use the superseded, damaged file in `data/truth/` or attempt to reproduce it from the wrong source (the MLP crosswalk), failing to replicate the paper\'s results. Contradictory documentation undermines provenance auditability.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied; claims-vs-code review could not verify whether manuscript text, tables, or in-text claims have already been updated in Overleaf or other external files.
The full multi-hour Stata pipeline was not executed in this review environment; downstream JW and HLINK exact cell values could not be generated and validated against machine A.
Data files outside machine B (e.g., machine A intermediate inputs used by `CODE/create_linked_sample_for_MLP_training.do`) were not directly readable.
The paper repository and output folders outside this git tree were not accessible for direct working-tree diffing.
structured_output.summary: The working-tree modifications correctly point machine B's linkage analysis and replication preflight to machine A's complete 36,690,338-pair truth file and record the superseded file's checksum. However, the change is incomplete: the downstream ABE, JW, and HLINK linkage tables and draft exhibits have not been rerun or updated, leaving existing reported results based on the damaged truth set. Furthermore, package documentation (`truth_file_provenance.md`, `LINKAGE/DOCUMENTATION.md`, and `replication/README.md`) has not yet been updated and still points to the damaged file and incorrect provenance.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
